#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Runner-local conservative budget overlay; immutable guard15 source/proof/cap logic is unchanged.
One3h chunk reserves90s for receipt shutdown. Every guard15 admission (including post-token/post-BigLock) needs
2400s left, deliberately conservative for native600/check1200 plus existing grace/TERM/reader-feed margins.
Token-count polling also checks it, so token wait defers before consuming the allowance. A single runner alarm at
the reserved cutoff breaks token/BigLock waits only when no owned child is alive/starting. With a live/starting
child it merely sets ABORT, never signals it; guard15's existing native limits/owned-child quarantine remain in
force and no further stage is admitted. Survivor quarantine is not an instantaneous wall/RSS hard-cap claim.
Timer is armed ONLY around an existing staged call, not while writing outer receipts. No extra process/thread.
"""
import signal
import time


class ChunkBudget:
    def __init__(self, guard, run_deadline_wall, chunk_seconds=10800, reserve_seconds=90, allowance_seconds=2400):
        self.guard = guard
        self.allowance = allowance_seconds
        self.deadline = min(time.monotonic()+chunk_seconds-reserve_seconds,
                            time.monotonic()+run_deadline_wall-time.time()-reserve_seconds)
        self.base_reason = guard.admitted_reason
        self.base_count = guard.token_count
        self.alarm_fired = False
        self.active = False

    def reason(self):
        why = self.base_reason()
        if why:
            return why
        if self.alarm_fired or time.monotonic()+self.allowance > self.deadline:
            return 'chunk/run budget: conservative next-stage allowance does not fit'
        return None

    def _count(self):
        why = self.reason()
        if why:
            raise self.guard.AdmissionDenied(why)
        return self.base_count()

    def _alarm(self, signum, frame):
        self.alarm_fired = True
        self.guard.ABORT[0] = True
        with self.guard._alock:
            live = any(p.poll() is None for p in self.guard.ACTIVE)
        if not live and not self.guard.SPAWNING[0]:
            raise self.guard.AdmissionDenied('chunk/run reserved cutoff while waiting; no child started')
        # Do not send an extra signal to an owned native/quarantined child. The immutable guard retains capacity.

    def __enter__(self):
        why = self.reason()
        if why:
            raise self.guard.AdmissionDenied(why)
        assert not self.active and self.guard.admitted_reason is self.base_reason and self.guard.token_count is self.base_count
        if signal.getitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL) != (0.0,0.0):
            raise RuntimeError('refuse to replace a pre-existing runner timer')
        self.old_handler = signal.getsignal(signal.SIGALRM)
        self.guard.admitted_reason = self.reason
        self.guard.token_count = self._count
        try:
            signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,self._alarm)
            signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL,max(0.001,self.deadline-time.monotonic()))
        except BaseException:
            self.guard.admitted_reason = self.base_reason
            self.guard.token_count = self.base_count
            signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,self.old_handler)
            raise
        self.active = True
        return self

    def __exit__(self,*exc):
        signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL,0)
        self.guard.admitted_reason = self.base_reason
        self.guard.token_count = self.base_count
        signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,self.old_handler)
        self.active = False

def dump(p,obj):
    p = Path(p); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)

def lock_free(p):

    try:
        try: fcntl.flock(fd,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)

def census_ref(root,usage=1,age=0.0):
    rec = {'schema':'PA19-ALLOCATED-CENSUS-v3','started_monotonic':time.monotonic()-age,'finished_monotonic':time.monotonic()-age,

def lease(root,deadline,owner=None,usage=1,age=0.0):

            'group_rss_cap_bytes':R.GROUP_RSS_CAP,'busy_units':2,'lane_busy_ceiling':4,

def providers(**changes):

def child(mode,path,extra):
    cfg = json.loads(Path(path).read_bytes())
    if mode == 'mark':
        dump(cfg['marker'],{'new_child':True}); return
    if mode == 'late':
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIG_IGN)
        dump(cfg['marker'],{'pid':os.getpid()})
        time.sleep(2.0); return
    if mode == 'floor-worker':
        dump(cfg['worker_result'],cfg['native']); return
    if mode == 'emit':
        kind = extra[0]
        if (cfg.get('start_failure') or cfg.get('thread_failure')) and kind == 'solver':
            signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIG_IGN)
            dump(cfg['marker'],{'pid':os.getpid()}); time.sleep(2.0); return
        with open(extra[1],'rb') as f: f.read()
        if kind == 'solver' and cfg.get('delayed_publication'):
            with open(extra[2],'wb') as f: f.write(b'\0'*65536)  # exceeds the control-only small raw cap
            time.sleep(1.0); raise SystemExit(0)  # alive at the cap-induced bounded exit, gone before worker exit
        if kind == 'solver':
            with open(extra[2],'wb') as f: f.write(b'')
            out,rc = cfg.get('solver_lines','s UNSATISFIABLE\n'),20
        else:
            sys.stdin.buffer.read(); out,rc = cfg.get('checker_lines','s VERIFIED\n'),cfg.get('checker_rc',0)
        sys.stdout.write(out); sys.stdout.flush(); raise SystemExit(rc)
    assert mode == 'pipeline'

    if cfg.get('feed_fault'):

            base(fifo,data[:len(data)//2] if side == cfg['feed_fault'] else data,record,stop,deadline)
        N.feed_cnf = short
    if cfg.get('fd_error'):
        side,operation = cfg['fd_error'].split('-'); target = Path(cfg['job']['workdir'])/(side+'-cnf.fifo')
        ow,oc = os.write,os.close
        def matches(fd):
            try: return os.fstat(fd).st_ino == target.stat().st_ino
            except OSError: return False
        def write(fd,data):
            if operation == 'write' and matches(fd): raise OSError('CONTROL CNF write failure')
            return ow(fd,data)
        def close(fd):
            fail = operation == 'close' and matches(fd); oc(fd)
            if fail: raise OSError('CONTROL CNF close failure after close')
        os.write,os.close = write,close
    if cfg.get('thread_failure'):
        start = threading.Thread.start
        def failing(thread):
            if thread._target is N.collector:
                time.sleep(0.2); dump(cfg['injection_marker'],{'injected':'CONTROL collector start failure'})
                raise RuntimeError('CONTROL collector start failure')
            return start(thread)
        threading.Thread.start = failing
    natives = []

        # worker's main thread has begun its bounded-exit stop. v6 must still settle and classify it.
        N.MAX_RAW = 1000
        released = threading.Event()
        OriginalEvent = threading.Event
        class BoundedExitEvent(OriginalEvent):
            def set(self):
                if threading.current_thread() is threading.main_thread(): released.set()
                return super().set()
        threading.Event = BoundedExitEvent
        real_feed = N.feed_cnf
        def delayed(fifo,data,record,stop,deadline):
            private = {}
            real_feed(fifo,data,private,stop,deadline)
            if 'solver-cnf' in str(fifo):
                assert released.wait(30), 'bounded exit never began'
                time.sleep(0.2)
                dump(cfg['injection_marker'],{'published_after_bounded_exit_stop':True,'feed':private})
            record.update(private)
        N.feed_cnf = delayed
        real_start = N.start_native
        def capture(*args,**kwargs):
            p,t = real_start(*args,**kwargs); natives.append(p); return p,t
        N.start_native = capture
    def commands(paths):
        if cfg.get('real_positive'):
            return ([N.KISSAT,'-q','-f','--seed=1','--time=600',paths['solver-cnf.fifo'],paths['proof.fifo']],[N.DT,paths['checker-cnf.fifo'],'-i','-t','1200'])
        solver = [sys.executable,'-B',str(SELF),'--child','emit',str(path),'solver',paths['solver-cnf.fifo'],paths['proof.fifo']]
        checker = [N.DT,paths['checker-cnf.fifo'],'-i','-t','1200'] if cfg.get('real_negative') else [sys.executable,'-B',str(SELF),'--child','emit',str(path),'checker',paths['checker-cnf.fifo']]
        return solver,checker
    def hook(p):
        time.sleep(0.2); dump(cfg['injection_marker'],{'injected':'CONTROL post-Popen exception'})
        raise RuntimeError('CONTROL post-Popen exception')
    result = N.pipeline(raw,cfg['job'],commands,hook if cfg.get('start_failure') else None)
    for p in natives: p.wait(10)  # control-only: clean supervision proves the veto does not rely on a supervisor trip
    dump(cfg['result'],result)


def native_case(root,name,**options):

            'integrity_status':result['integrity_status']},result,rec,cap.settlement)

    renewed = R.census_for_gate(census_ref(priv,7,R.CENSUS_TTL+5),False,priv)
    assert renewed['reference'] != fresh['reference'] and renewed['age_seconds'] <= R.CENSUS_TTL
    rows.append({'name':'real-census-cache-and-refresh','fresh_age':fresh['age_seconds'],'renewed_reference':renewed['reference']})

def postwait_controls(root):
    rows = []
    causes = {'STOP':'STOP/veto STOP-m2r12','floor':'fresh statvfs growth/floor gate','binary':'contract binary drift',
              'data':'allocated-data cap with whole-plan reservation/margin','old-marker':'STOP/veto m2k1-HALT.flag'}
    for change in ('STOP','floor','binary','data','old-marker'):
        folder = root/('postwait-'+change); folder.mkdir(); priv = folder/'scope'; scope(priv)
        token = os.open(priv/'cycle2/tokens/t0',os.O_RDWR); fcntl.flock(token,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        (priv/'cycle2/tokens/COUNT').write_text('1\n')
        free = [R.BASE_GATE+R.ITEM_GROWTH]; drift = [False]; usage = [1]; original = R.full_gate; result = {}
        R.full_gate = lambda item,phase,lane=None: original(item,phase,priv,providers(free=lambda:free[0],
            binaries=lambda:{k:{'matches':not (drift[0] and k == 'solver')} for k in ('python','solver','checker')},
            census=lambda:{'reference':{},'age_seconds':0,'finished_monotonic':time.monotonic(),'current_data_upper_bytes':usage[0]}))
        config = folder/'marker.json'; dump(config,{'marker':str(folder/'FORBIDDEN.json')})
        entered,finished = threading.Event(),threading.Event()
        def admit():
            try:
                entered.set()
                with R.Capacity(time.monotonic()+8000,priv) as cap:
                    item = lease(priv,time.monotonic()+8000); item['owner_pid'] = os.getpid()
                    rec,gate = cap.supervise([sys.executable,'-B',str(SELF),'--child','mark',str(config)],'CONTROL-postwait',item,
                                             folder/'supervisor.json',folder/'quarantine.json')
                    result.update(rec=rec,gate=gate)
            except BaseException as exc: result['error'] = repr(exc)
            finally: finished.set()
        th = threading.Thread(target=admit,daemon=True); th.start()
        try:
            assert entered.wait(5); time.sleep(0.2)
            if change == 'STOP': (priv/'cycle2/STOP-m2r12').write_text('CONTROL during wait')
            elif change == 'floor': free[0] -= 1
            elif change == 'binary': drift[0] = True
            elif change == 'data': usage[0] = R.DATA_CAP
            else: (priv/'cycle2/m2k1-HALT.flag').write_text('{"CONTROL":"old v1 persistent veto appears during capacity wait"}')
            fcntl.flock(token,fcntl.LOCK_UN); os.close(token); token = None
            assert finished.wait(5) and result.get('rec') is None and not result['gate']['admitted'], result
            assert result['gate']['errors'] == [causes[change]], (change,result['gate']['errors'])
            assert not (folder/'FORBIDDEN.json').exists() and not (folder/'supervisor.json').exists()
            rows.append({'change':change,'errors':result['gate']['errors'],'new_children':0})
        finally:
            if token is not None: fcntl.flock(token,fcntl.LOCK_UN); os.close(token)
            R.full_gate = original
    return rows


def late_reap_control(root):
    folder = root/'late-leader-reap'; folder.mkdir(); priv = folder/'scope'; scope(priv)
    config = folder/'late.json'; dump(config,{'marker':str(folder/'marker.json')})
    original,sup = R.full_gate,R.supervisor().supervise
    R.full_gate = lambda item,phase,lane=None: original(item,phase,priv,providers(free=lambda:(lambda s:s.f_bavail*s.f_frsize)(os.statvfs(L)),
        rss=lambda:R.lane_rss(L,owner=os.getpid())))

    return shadow

        namespace = dict(fn.__globals__); exec(compile(tree,str(root/(name+'.py')),'exec'),namespace)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent second enumerator (M2) of one-column placements for A2 cases whose special
columns are all P1 = (4,4,3,...,3,2); shares no code with extend_p1.py / extend_p1q.py.

Input: a gen_skel_b skeleton (row types + #empty rows). Rows (M2 order): the listed types,
then 4-deg(v) private rows of each P0 column v, then the empty rows. Rows with identical P0
membership form a class; their rows are interchangeable. A placement of the first special
column = disjoint blocks A, B (4 rows) and P (2 rows), each block pairwise without a common
P0 quad, subject to the row budget with the remaining ns-1 free special columns:
  |T(r)| + e(r) - (ns-1) <= 2  and  |T(r)| + e(r) + (ns-1) >= 2 - L
(e = +1 in A/B, 0 in a triple, -1 in P). Up to row symmetry a placement is a choice, for each
class, of how many of its rows go to A, B, P (a class with a nonempty P0 set contributes at
most one row per block). Placements are then identified under the automorphism group of the
skeleton (P0 column permutations preserving the type multiset, found by brute force over all
c0! permutations) and the A/B swap; one canonical representative per orbit is output.
Usage: extend_b.py SKEL_B_JSON INDEX OUT_JSON
"""
import itertools
import json
import sys


def main():
    path, idx, out = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3]
    d = json.load(open(path))
    sk = d["skeletons"][idx]
    c0, L = d["c0"], d["L"]
    q = len(d["profiles"][0])
    P0 = [4] + [3] * (q - 1)
    special = [p for p in d["profiles"] if list(p) != P0]
    ns = len(special)
    assert all(sorted(p, reverse=True) == [4, 4] + [3] * (q - 3) + [2] for p in special)
    types = [tuple(t) for t in sk["types"]]
    deg = [0] * c0
    for t in types:
        for v in t:
            deg[v] += 1
    member = [frozenset(t) for t in types]
    for v in range(c0):
        member += [frozenset([v])] * (4 - deg[v])
    member += [frozenset()] * sk["empty"]
    N = len(member)
    assert N == 3 * q + 1
    classes = []  # (member set, [rows])
    for r, ms in enumerate(member):
        for cl in classes:
            if cl[0] == ms:
                cl[1].append(r)
                break
        else:
            classes.append((ms, [r]))
    K = len(classes)

    def ok_row(t, e):
        return t + e - (ns - 1) <= 2 and t + e + (ns - 1) >= 2 - L

    # per class allowed (a, b, p) counts
    opts = []
    for ms, rows in classes:
        t = len(ms)
        cap = len(rows)
        per_block = 1 if ms else cap
        o = []
        for a in range(min(per_block, cap) + 1):
            for b in range(min(per_block, cap - a) + 1):
                for p in range(min(per_block, cap - a - b) + 1):
                    rest = cap - a - b - p
                    good = True
                    if a + b and not ok_row(t, 1):
                        good = False
                    if p and not ok_row(t, -1):
                        good = False
                    if rest and not ok_row(t, 0):
                        good = False
                    if good:
                        o.append((a, b, p))
        opts.append(o)
    results = []

    def compatible(sel, k, need):
        # blocks pairwise without common P0 quad: classes with nonempty sets in the same block
        # must have disjoint sets
        return True

    def rec(k, sel, sa, sb, sp):
        if sa > 4 or sb > 4 or sp > 2:
            return
        if k == K:
            if sa == 4 and sb == 4 and sp == 2:
                results.append(tuple(sel))
            return
        ms = classes[k][0]
        for a, b, p in opts[k]:
            bad = False
            for j in range(k):
                aj, bj, pj = sel[j]
                if ms and classes[j][0] and (ms & classes[j][0]):
                    if (a and aj) or (b and bj) or (p and pj):
                        bad = True
                        break
            if bad:
                continue
            sel.append((a, b, p))
            rec(k + 1, sel, sa + a, sb + b, sp + p)
            sel.pop()

    rec(0, [], 0, 0, 0)
    # automorphisms of the skeleton
    tset = sorted(tuple(sorted(t)) for t in types)
    auts = []
    for perm in itertools.permutations(range(c0)):
        if sorted(tuple(sorted(perm[v] for v in t)) for t in types) == tset:
            auts.append(perm)
    cls_sets = [tuple(sorted(ms)) for ms, _ in classes]
    reps = {}
    for sel in results:
        best = None
        for perm in auts:
            mapped = []
            for (ms, _), (a, b, p) in zip(classes, sel):
                mapped.append((tuple(sorted(perm[v] for v in ms)), a, b, p))
            for swap in (False, True):
                key = tuple(sorted((m, b, a, p) if swap else (m, a, b, p) for m, a, b, p in mapped))
                if best is None or key < best:
                    best = key
        reps.setdefault(best, sel)
    placements = []
    for key, sel in sorted(reps.items()):
        A, B, P = [], [], []
        for (ms, rows), (a, b, p) in zip(classes, sel):
            A += rows[:a]
            B += rows[a:a + b]
            P += rows[a + b:a + b + p]
        placements.append([sorted(A), sorted(B), sorted(P)])
    json.dump({"source": path, "index": idx, "raw_class_assignments": len(results), "automorphisms": len(auts),
               "num_placements": len(placements), "placements": placements}, open(out, "w"))
    print(json.dumps({"index": idx, "raw": len(results), "aut": len(auts), "num_placements": len(placements)}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

class, of how many of its rows go to A, B, P (a class with a nonempty P0 set contributes at
most one row per block). Placements are then identified under the automorphism group of the
skeleton (P0 column permutations preserving the type multiset, found by brute force over all
c0! permutations) and the A/B swap; one canonical representative per orbit is output.
Usage: extend_b.py SKEL_B_JSON INDEX OUT_JSON
"""
import itertools
import json
import sys


def main():
    path, idx, out = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3]
    d = json.load(open(path))
    sk = d["skeletons"][idx]
    c0, L = d["c0"], d["L"]
    q = len(d["profiles"][0])
    P0 = [4] + [3] * (q - 1)
    special = [p for p in d["profiles"] if list(p) != P0]
    ns = len(special)
    assert all(sorted(p, reverse=True) == [4, 4] + [3] * (q - 3) + [2] for p in special)
    types = [tuple(t) for t in sk["types"]]
    deg = [0] * c0
    for t in types:
        for v in t:
            deg[v] += 1
    member = [frozenset(t) for t in types]
    for v in range(c0):
        member += [frozenset([v])] * (4 - deg[v])
    member += [frozenset()] * sk["empty"]
    N = len(member)
    assert N == 3 * q + 1
    classes = []  # (member set, [rows])
    for r, ms in enumerate(member):
        for cl in classes:
            if cl[0] == ms:
                cl[1].append(r)
                break
        else:
            classes.append((ms, [r]))
    K = len(classes)

    def ok_row(t, e):
        return t + e - (ns - 1) <= 2 and t + e + (ns - 1) >= 2 - L

    # per class allowed (a, b, p) counts
    opts = []
    for ms, rows in classes:
        t = len(ms)
        cap = len(rows)
        per_block = 1 if ms else cap
        o = []
        for a in range(min(per_block, cap) + 1):
            for b in range(min(per_block, cap - a) + 1):
                for p in range(min(per_block, cap - a - b) + 1):
                    rest = cap - a - b - p
                    good = True
                    if a + b and not ok_row(t, 1):
                        good = False
                    if p and not ok_row(t, -1):
                        good = False
                    if rest and not ok_row(t, 0):
                        good = False
                    if good:
                        o.append((a, b, p))
        opts.append(o)
    results = []

    def compatible(sel, k, need):
        # blocks pairwise without common P0 quad: classes with nonempty sets in the same block
        # must have disjoint sets
        return True

    def rec(k, sel, sa, sb, sp):
        if sa > 4 or sb > 4 or sp > 2:
            return
        if k == K:
            if sa == 4 and sb == 4 and sp == 2:
                results.append(tuple(sel))
            return
        ms = classes[k][0]
        for a, b, p in opts[k]:
            bad = False
            for j in range(k):
                aj, bj, pj = sel[j]
                if ms and classes[j][0] and (ms & classes[j][0]):
                    if (a and aj) or (b and bj) or (p and pj):
                        bad = True
                        break
            if bad:
                continue
            sel.append((a, b, p))
            rec(k + 1, sel, sa + a, sb + b, sp + p)
            sel.pop()

    rec(0, [], 0, 0, 0)
    # automorphisms of the skeleton
    tset = sorted(tuple(sorted(t)) for t in types)
    auts = []
    for perm in itertools.permutations(range(c0)):
        if sorted(tuple(sorted(perm[v] for v in t)) for t in types) == tset:
            auts.append(perm)
    cls_sets = [tuple(sorted(ms)) for ms, _ in classes]
    reps = {}
    for sel in results:
        best = None
        for perm in auts:
            mapped = []
            for (ms, _), (a, b, p) in zip(classes, sel):
                mapped.append((tuple(sorted(perm[v] for v in ms)), a, b, p))
            for swap in (False, True):
                key = tuple(sorted((m, b, a, p) if swap else (m, a, b, p) for m, a, b, p in mapped))
                if best is None or key < best:
                    best = key
        reps.setdefault(best, sel)
    placements = []
    for key, sel in sorted(reps.items()):
        A, B, P = [], [], []
        for (ms, rows), (a, b, p) in zip(classes, sel):
            A += rows[:a]
            B += rows[a:a + b]
            P += rows[a + b:a + b + p]
        placements.append([sorted(A), sorted(B), sorted(P)])
    json.dump({"source": path, "index": idx, "raw_class_assignments": len(results), "automorphisms": len(auts),
               "num_placements": len(placements), "placements": placements}, open(out, "x"))
    print(json.dumps({"index": idx, "raw": len(results), "aut": len(auts), "num_placements": len(placements)}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent second generator (M2) for the A2 P0-quad skeletons; shares no code with
gen_skel.py beyond the profile list (recomputed here independently).

Representation: a skeleton is a bicoloured graph, first class = rows lying in >= 2 P0
quads (degree 2..tmax), second class = the c0 P0 quads (degree <= 4); two quads share <= 1
row (genbg -Z1 on the second class). nauty genbg enumerates these up to isomorphism
preserving the two classes, for every number h of first-class vertices (0 <= h <= 2*c0).
Rows in exactly one quad (4 - degree per quad) and rows in no quad complete the 19 rows.
Filters (same necessary conditions as README A2, re-derived): rows in >= 3 quads lie in a
size-<=2 block of a special column, so their number is <= hmax; total rows <= 19; with one
special column its multiset of e = size - 3 must be assignable to rows with
0 <= 2 - |T| - e <= L (checked here by brute-force bipartite matching).
Output: skeletons-b-msXX.json with each skeleton as a list of row types (sorted tuples).
Usage (research venv): gen_skel_b.py MS_INDEX OUTDIR
"""
import itertools
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

import networkx as nx

GENBG = "/opt/homebrew/bin/genbg"


def partitions19():
    out = []

    def rec(n, k, mx, acc):
        if k == 0:
            if n == 0:
                out.append(tuple(acc))
            return
        for x in range(min(n, mx), -1, -1):
            rec(n - x, k - 1, x, acc + [x])

    rec(19, 6, 19, [])
    return out


def kap(p):
    return sum(x * (x - 1) // 2 for x in p)


def multisets():
    parts = [p for p in partitions19()]
    kmin = min(kap(p) for p in parts)
    budget = 171 - 8 * kmin
    profs = [p for p in parts if kap(p) - kmin <= budget]
    profs.sort(key=lambda p: (kap(p), [-x for x in p]))
    res = []
    for combo in itertools.combinations_with_replacement(range(len(profs)), 8):
        ex = sum(kap(profs[i]) - kmin for i in combo)
        if ex <= budget:
            res.append(([profs[i] for i in combo], budget - ex))
    return res, kmin


def matchable(tsizes, evals, L):
    # bipartite matching rows -> e-values with 0 <= 2 - t - e <= L (Kuhn's algorithm)
    n = len(tsizes)
    adj = [[j for j, e in enumerate(evals) if 0 <= 2 - t - e <= L] for t in tsizes]
    match = [-1] * len(evals)

    def aug(i, seen):
        for j in adj[i]:
            if not seen[j]:
                seen[j] = True
                if match[j] < 0 or aug(match[j], seen):
                    match[j] = i
                    return True
        return False

    return all(aug(i, [False] * len(evals)) for i in range(n))


def main():
    mi, outdir = int(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2]
    ms, kmin = multisets()
    profs, L = ms[mi]
    P0 = (4, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3)
    c0 = sum(1 for p in profs if p == P0)
    X = [p for p in profs if p != P0]
    wmin = sum(min(x - 3 for x in p) for p in X)
    tmax = min(c0, 2 - wmin)
    hmax = sum(x for p in X for x in p if x <= 2)
    evals = [x - 3 for x in X[0] for _ in range(x)] if len(X) == 1 else None
    out = []
    counts = {}
    for h in range(0, 2 * c0 + 1):
        if h == 0:
            graphs = [None]
        else:
            cmd = [GENBG, "-q", "-Z1", "-d2:0", "-D%d:4" % tmax, str(h), str(c0)]
            graphs = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split()
        kept = 0
        for g6 in graphs:
            if g6 is None:
                types = []
            else:
                G = nx.from_graph6_bytes(g6.encode())
                types = [tuple(sorted(v - h for v in G.neighbors(r))) for r in range(h)]
            deg = [0] * c0
            for t in types:
                for v in t:
                    deg[v] += 1
            if any(d > 4 for d in deg):
                continue
            big = sum(1 for t in types if len(t) >= 3)
            if big > hmax:
                continue
            nrows = len(types) + sum(4 - d for d in deg)
            if nrows > 19:
                continue
            empty = 19 - nrows
            tsizes = [len(t) for t in types] + [1] * sum(4 - d for d in deg) + [0] * empty

    print(json.dumps({"multiset_index": mi, "c0": c0, "L": L, "tmax": tmax, "hmax": hmax,

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Conservative byte accounting for the original additional lane-data cap (no data mutation).
The known cycle-2 baseline is 2026-10-17 05:23 PDT (checkpoints.md checkpoint1). Use the EARLIER 05:22:00 cutoff;
charge the FULL current size/allocation of every lane entry born OR modified at/after that cutoff (including
archives/caches/directories), and every entry lacking a readable birth time. Thus copies with preserved mtimes are
still charged by birth time; modified baseline files are charged in full rather than just net growth; moves retain
the same charged bytes. Pre-cutoff unchanged baseline proof/CNF data is not new data. Hardlinks are conservatively
charged per path. Count both logical bytes and st_blocks*512 exactly over this conservative selected set; usage is
the larger sum. This is an upper-bound accounting set, not an invented exact pre-run file inventory.
Enforce10,000,000,000B (stricter than the parent10GiB cap); also report remaining allowance under10GiB. Any stat error
makes admission unknown/refused. No content read, deletion, compression or proof/CNF copies.
"""
import datetime
import os
import stat
import time

CUTOFF_ISO = '2026-10-17T05:22:00-07:00'
CUTOFF = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(CUTOFF_ISO).timestamp()
ENFORCED_CAP_BYTES = 10000000000
ORIGINAL_CAP_BYTES = 10 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024


def account(lane):
    logical = allocated = selected = total = 0
    errors = []
    pending = [os.fspath(lane)]
    while pending:
        path = pending.pop()
        try:
            st = os.lstat(path)
        except OSError as exc:
            errors.append({'path': os.path.relpath(path, lane), 'error': str(exc)})
            continue
        total += 1
        born = getattr(st, 'st_birthtime', None)
        charge = born is None or born >= CUTOFF or st.st_mtime >= CUTOFF
        if charge:
            selected += 1
            logical += st.st_size
            allocated += getattr(st, 'st_blocks', (st.st_size + 511) // 512) * 512
        if stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode):
            try:
                with os.scandir(path) as entries:
                    pending.extend(entry.path for entry in entries)
            except OSError as exc:
                errors.append({'path': os.path.relpath(path, lane), 'error': str(exc)})
    usage = max(logical, allocated)
    return {'host_clock': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'), 'policy': 'conservative full-byte charge by birth-or-modification cutoff; not net baseline subtraction',
            'cutoff_host_clock': CUTOFF_ISO, 'entries_seen': total, 'entries_charged': selected,
            'charged_logical_bytes': logical, 'charged_allocated_bytes': allocated,
            'new_data_usage_upper_bytes': usage, 'original_10gib_cap_bytes': ORIGINAL_CAP_BYTES,
            'remaining_original_allowance_bytes': ORIGINAL_CAP_BYTES - usage,
            'enforced_cap_bytes': ENFORCED_CAP_BYTES, 'remaining_enforced_allowance_bytes': ENFORCED_CAP_BYTES - usage,
            'stat_errors': errors, 'known': not errors}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""V3: one attempt, contract-authoritative binaries, retained Popen reaping, safety-first UNKNOWN/integrity veto.
No automatic RSS retry. A safety trip always dominates a worker's bounded-UNKNOWN/proof-cap report. Every veto is
persistent before token release; group quiescence AND explicit owned-leader wait are prerequisites for release.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

import m2_ms09_contract_v6 as C
import m2_supervised_runtime_v6 as R
import m2_supervised_evidence_v6 as EVIDENCE

L = C.LANE
WORKER = L/'src/m2_native_staged_v6.py'


def bounded_publish(path,value,stage,limit):
    raw = (json.dumps(value,indent=1)+'\n').encode()
    if len(raw) > limit: raise ValueError('frozen metadata publication bound exceeded')
    C.publish_bytes(path,raw,stage)
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def persist_veto(result,paths,contract_sha,recipe):
    if result.get('sat_candidate'):
        kind = 'SAT'
    elif result.get('integrity_status') == 'INVALID':
        kind = 'INTEGRITY'
    elif result.get('halt_production'):
        kind = 'HALT'
    else: return
    flag = L/'cycle2'/('m2k3-'+kind+'.flag')
    note = {'status':'UNKNOWN','veto':kind,'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),
        'production_contract_sha256':contract_sha,'recipe':recipe,'owner_pid':os.getpid(),
        'worker_result':str(Path(paths['worker_result']).relative_to(L)),
        'supervisor_record':str(Path(paths['supervisor']).relative_to(L)),
        'integrity_errors':result.get('integrity_errors'),'safety_veto':result.get('safety_veto'),
        'scope':'persistent unverified SAT / integrity / safety hold; scientific result UNKNOWN'}
    while not flag.exists():
        try:
            with flag.open('x') as f: json.dump(note,f,indent=1)
            return
        except FileExistsError: return
        except OSError: time.sleep(0.25)  # token stays owned throughout this receipt-only wait


def supervisor_safety_errors(rec,settlement):
    errors = []
    if rec.get('completed_cleanly') is not True: errors.append('supervisor did not complete cleanly')
    for key in ('trip_reason','uncertain','exception','quarantine_record','quarantine_write_error','cleanup_exception','record_write_error','stop_error'):
        if rec.get(key): errors.append(key+': '+str(rec[key]))
    stop = rec.get('stop') or {}
    if stop: errors.append('supervisor performed safety-stop cleanup')
    if stop.get('killpg_error'): errors.append('killpg_error: '+str(stop['killpg_error']))
    if not isinstance(settlement,dict) or settlement.get('group_quiescent') is not True or settlement.get('leader_reaped') is not True or settlement.get('explicit_owned_popen_wait') is not True:
        errors.append('group quiescence/explicit owned leader reaping not affirmed')
    return errors


def apply_worker_outcome(result,native,rec,settlement):
    """Shared actual production/control composition; a worker bounded-UNKNOWN can NEVER clear a safety hold."""
    safety = supervisor_safety_errors(rec,settlement)
    if safety:
        result.update(status='UNKNOWN',checked=False,halt_production=True,safety_veto=safety)
    elif native is not None:
        if native['status'] == 'UNSAT' and native['integrity_status'] == 'VALIDATED' and not native.get('sat_candidate') and not native.get('halt_production'):
            result.update(status='UNSAT',checked=True,halt_production=False)
        else:
            result.update(status='UNKNOWN',checked=False,halt_production=bool(native.get('halt_production') or result.get('sat_candidate') or native['integrity_status'] == 'INVALID'))
    result['chunk_stop'] = bool(result.get('halt_production') or (native or {}).get('chunk_stop'))
    return result


def execute(constructor,recipe,contract_sha,source_sha,paths,deadline,admission,solver='kissat',seconds=600):
    """All expectations derive from the frozen contract admission object; observed hashes NEVER become authority."""
    authority = admission['binary_authority']
    assert authority['solver']['path'] == '/opt/homebrew/bin/'+solver
    result = {'pipeline_schema':'PA19-SUPERVISED-DRAT-v6','status':'UNKNOWN','checked':False,
        'integrity_status':'NOT_EVALUATED','integrity_errors':[],'sat_candidate':False,'halt_production':False,
        'group_started':False,'production_contract_sha256':contract_sha,'multiset':recipe['multiset'],'b_index':recipe['b_index'],
        'indices':recipe.get('indices'),'encoder':'encode_skel_b.build_v2' if recipe['mode'] == 'direct' else 'encode_skel_b.build_partbatch',
        'recipe':recipe,'proof_retained':False,'cnf_retained':False,'solver_name':solver,'native_limit_seconds':seconds,
        'checker_limit_seconds':1200,'binary_authority':authority,'automatic_retry_allowed':False}
    stage = Path(paths['staging'])
    with R.Capacity(deadline) as capacity:
        try:
            now = time.monotonic()
            lease = {'owner_pid':os.getpid(),'projected_growth_bytes':R.ITEM_GROWTH,
                'census_reference':admission['census_reference'],'whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes':admission['whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes'],
                'force_census_refresh':capacity.wait_seconds > R.CENSUS_TTL,'binary_authority':authority,
                'group_rss_cap_bytes':R.GROUP_RSS_CAP,'busy_units':2,'lane_busy_ceiling':4,
                'chunk_deadline_monotonic':deadline,'item_deadline_monotonic':now+2400}
            pre = R.full_gate(lease,'construct')
            result['owner_preconstruction_gate'] = pre
            if not pre['admitted']:
                # refusal rule1: before any pin/job; unattempted, no record and no persistent HALT.
                result.update(resource_refusal=pre['errors'],unattempted='before-pin',halt_production=False,chunk_stop=True)
                return result
            raw = constructor()
            h,nbytes = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),len(raw)
            result.update(cnf_sha256=h,cnf_bytes=nbytes)
            pin = {'schema':'PA19-K1-CNF-PIN-v6','host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),
                'production_contract_sha256':contract_sha,'multiset':recipe['multiset'],'b_index':recipe['b_index'],
                'indices':recipe.get('indices'),'cnf_sha256':h,'cnf_bytes':nbytes,'recipe':recipe,'source_sha256':source_sha,
                'supervisor_sha256':R.SUP_SHA,'binary_authority':authority,'no_cnf_or_proof_retained':True}
            pin_sha = bounded_publish(paths['pin'],pin,stage,16384)
            result.update(pre_child_pin_sha256=pin_sha,pre_child_pin_path=str(Path(paths['pin']).relative_to(L)))
            lease['item_deadline_monotonic'] = time.monotonic()+2400
            job = {'schema':'PA19-NATIVE-JOB-v6','recipe':recipe,'cnf_sha256':h,'cnf_bytes':nbytes,'solver':solver,
                'solver_seconds':seconds,'checker_seconds':1200,'lease':lease,'source_sha256':source_sha,'binary_authority':authority,
                'workdir':str(paths['workdir']),'result_path':str(paths['worker_result'])}
            job_sha = bounded_publish(paths['job'],job,stage,16384)
            del raw
            command = [authority['python']['path'],'-B',str(WORKER),str(paths['job']),job_sha]
            rec,gate = capacity.supervise(command,'PA19-'+paths['id'],lease,paths['supervisor'],paths['quarantine'])
            result['owner_prespawn_gate'] = gate
            if rec is None:
                # refusal rule2: pin/job exist but no worker process started; runner retires own metadata, no record/HALT.
                result.update(resource_refusal=gate['errors'],unattempted='after-pin-before-worker',halt_production=False,chunk_stop=True)
                return result
            result.update(group_started=rec.get('leader_pid') is not None,supervisor_record=str(Path(paths['supervisor']).relative_to(L)),
                supervisor_record_sha256=R.digest(paths['supervisor']) if Path(paths['supervisor']).exists() else None,
                supervisor=rec,owner_settlement=capacity.settlement,job_path=str(Path(paths['job']).relative_to(L)),job_sha256=job_sha)
            safety = supervisor_safety_errors(rec,capacity.settlement)
            native = None
            try:
                native = json.loads(Path(paths['worker_result']).read_bytes())
                assert native['schema'] == 'PA19-NATIVE-RESULT-v6' and native['status'] in ('UNSAT','UNKNOWN')
                assert native['integrity_status'] in ('VALIDATED','INVALID','NOT_EVALUATED')
                result.update(native_result=native,worker_result_path=str(Path(paths['worker_result']).relative_to(L)),
                              worker_result_sha256=R.digest(paths['worker_result']))
                result.update(sat_candidate=bool(native.get('sat_candidate')),integrity_status=native['integrity_status'],
                              integrity_errors=list(native.get('integrity_errors') or []))
            except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,AssertionError) as exc:
                if supervisor_safety_errors(rec,capacity.settlement):
                    result['worker_report_missing_after_safety_stop'] = repr(exc)  # safety HALT below; not evidence corruption
                else:
                    result.update(integrity_status='INVALID',integrity_errors=['worker report unavailable/invalid: '+repr(exc)],halt_production=True)
            apply_worker_outcome(result,native,rec,capacity.settlement)
            if result['status'] == 'UNSAT':
                ex = {'multiset':recipe['multiset'],'b_index':recipe['b_index'],'indices':recipe.get('indices'),'encoder':result['encoder'],
                    'cnf_sha256':h,'cnf_bytes':nbytes,'native_limit':seconds,'binary_authority':authority,
                    'source_sha256':source_sha,'recipe':recipe}
                errors = EVIDENCE.proof_errors(result,ex,L)
                result['proof_qualification_errors'] = errors
                if errors: result.update(status='UNKNOWN',checked=False,integrity_status='INVALID',integrity_errors=errors,halt_production=True)
            if result['status'] == 'UNSAT' and (Path(paths['supervisor']).stat().st_size > 8192 or len((json.dumps(result,indent=1)+'\n').encode()) > 65536):
                result.update(status='UNKNOWN',checked=False,halt_production=True,metadata_bound_error='ordinary supervisor/owner8KiB/64KiB bound')
            return result
        except BaseException as exc:
            result.update(status='UNKNOWN',checked=False,integrity_status='INVALID',integrity_errors=[repr(exc)],halt_production=True)
            return result
        finally:
            persist_veto(result,paths,contract_sha,recipe)

        order += [it['id'] for it in ca['intervals'] if not it['baseline'] and it['id'] not in required_reserved]
    assert c['pending_order'] == order, 'compute order is not the exact deterministic full unresolved partition'
    validations = c['validation_tasks']
    assert [x['id'] for x in validations] == CALIBRATION_VALIDATION_IDS+HISTORICAL_VALIDATION_IDS
    assert len({x['id'] for x in validations}) == 14 and c['validation_order'] == [x['id'] for x in validations]
    bytask = {it['id']:(ca,it) for ca in c['cases'] for it in ca['intervals']}
    direct_ca = c['cases'][1]
    assert direct_ca['direct_task'] == new_task(1,None)
    bytask['b00001:direct'] = direct_ca,direct_ca['direct_task']
    for val in validations:
        ca,it = bytask[val['id']]
        assert val['b_index'] == ca['b_index'] and val['indices'] == it['indices']
        ex = val['expected']
        assert ex['multiset'] == 9 and ex['b_index'] == ca['b_index'] and ex['indices'] == it['indices']
        assert val['source_class'] == ('CALIBRATION_ORIGINAL_COUNT_FALSE' if val['id'] in required_reserved else 'HISTORICAL_ORIGINAL_QUALIFIED')
        assert val['original_records'] and all(E.digest(LANE/x['path']) == x['sha256'] for x in val['original_records'])
        assert val['native_seconds'] == 600 and val['check_seconds'] == 1200
    assert c['reuse_policy'] == 'WITHDRAWN: only new measured-v3 exact-input validation may qualify historical inputs'


def structural_acceptance(c,ca):
    if not (type(ca['b_index']) is int and ca['b_index'] == 3 and type(ca['list']['n']) is int and ca['list']['n'] == 0
            and c['skeleton_sha256'] == SKELETON_SHA
            and ca['list']['sha256'] == B3.EXPECTED['empty_list_receipt']['sha256']):
        return {'accepted':False,'scope':'no generic empty-cover acceptance'}
    return B3.verify()


def load(path,h):
    assert E.digest(path) == h, 'production contract SHA differs'
    c = read(path)
    verify_sources(c)
    assert (c['native_seconds'],c['check_seconds'],c['chunk_seconds'],c['allowance_seconds']) == (600,1200,10800,2400)
    assert c['batch_size'] == 100 and c['count_ceiling'] == 2
    assert c['resource_policy'] == resource_policy()
    assert c['binary_authority']['solver']['path'] == '/opt/homebrew/bin/kissat'
    assert c['binary_authority']['checker']['path'] == str(LANE/'tools/drat-trim/drat-trim')
    assert set(c['binary_authority']) == {'python','solver','checker'}
    for authority in c['binary_authority'].values():
        assert Path(authority['path']).is_absolute() and E.SHA.fullmatch(authority['sha256'])
    return c


def resource_policy():
    return {'automatic_retry_allowed':False,'normal_group_rss_bytes':supervised_runtime.GROUP_RSS_CAP,
        'census_ttl_seconds':600,'other_writer_margin_bytes':256*1024**2,'fresh_statvfs_base_bytes':supervised_runtime.BASE_GATE,
        'whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes':supervised_runtime.ALL_PLANNED_RETAINED_BOUND,
        'residual':'whole-plan bound covers route writes; no other lane writer adds>256MiB within600s',
        'explicit_leader_wait_and_group_quiescence':True,'guards_are_sampled_not_instantaneous':True}


def formula(c,ca,indices):
    """EXACT original run_m2_15 constructor/arguments; no M1 encoder/clauses or new symmetry."""
    sp = LANE/c['skeleton_path']
    raw = sp.read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == c['skeleton_sha256']
    D = json.loads(raw)
    sk = D['skeletons'][ca['b_index']]
    assert hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sk,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest() == ca['skeleton_sha256']
    special = [p for p in D['profiles'] if list(p) != P0]
    if indices is None:
        nv,cl = ENC.build_v2(D['c0'],[tuple(t) for t in sk['types']],sk['empty'],special)
    else:
        ls = ca['list']
        raw = (LANE/ls['path']).read_bytes()
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == ls['sha256']
        data = json.loads(raw)
        assert data['num_placements'] == len(data['placements']) == ls['n'] > 0
        assert data['raw_class_assignments'] == ls['raw'] and data['automorphisms'] == ls['aut']
        lo,hi = indices
        nv,cl = ENC.build_partbatch(D['c0'],[tuple(t) for t in sk['types']],sk['empty'],special,
                                   [data['placements'][i] for i in range(lo,hi+1)])
    return ENC.cnf_bytes(nv,cl)


def context(bi,indices,sha,nbytes,kissat=False):
    return E.expected(9,bi,indices,sha,nbytes,'encode_skel_b.build_v2' if indices is None else 'encode_skel_b.build_partbatch',600,kissat)




def sat_scan():
    """Scan all actual ms09 scientific/calibration JSON, including unrecognized extra records; not controls."""
    paths = set((LANE/'cycle2'/'m2skel_drat').glob('ms09_b*.json'))
    for d in (LANE/'cycle2'/'m2part_drat').glob('ms09_b*'):
        if d.is_dir():
            paths.update(d.glob('*.json'))
    for pattern in ('m2-kissat-calibration-*','m2-kissat-strata-calibration-*'):
        for d in (LANE/'cycle2').glob(pattern):
            if d.is_dir():
                paths.update(d.glob('*.json'))
    paths.update((LANE/'cycle2'/'m2k1-chunks').glob('*/SAT-*.json'))
    paths.update((LANE/'cycle2'/'witness').glob('m2k1*.json'))
    aborted = LANE/'cycle2'/'aborted'
    paths.update(aborted.glob('*.json'))
    for name in supervised_runtime.PERSISTENT_VETO_FLAGS:
        flag = LANE/'cycle2'/name
        if flag.exists():
            paths.add(flag)
    sats,invalid = [],[]
    for p in sorted(paths):
        try:
            r = read(p)
        except (OSError,ValueError,UnicodeError) as exc:
            invalid.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(LANE)),'error':repr(exc)})
            continue
        if not isinstance(r,dict):
            invalid.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(LANE)),'error':'scientific JSON is not an object'})
            continue
        if p.parent == aborted and not (r.get('multiset') == 9 or 'ms09_' in str(r.get('fifo_dir','')) or str(r.get('tag','')).startswith('ms09_')):
            continue
        inner = r.get('native_result') if isinstance(r.get('native_result'),dict) else {}
        checker = inner.get('checker_collector') if isinstance(inner.get('checker_collector'),dict) else {}
        if r.get('status') == 'SAT' or inner.get('status') == 'SAT' or r.get('sat_candidate') is True or inner.get('sat_candidate') is True or p.name in supervised_runtime.SAT_VETO_FLAGS:
            sats.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(LANE)),'sha256':E.digest(p)})
        if r.get('integrity_status') == 'INVALID' or inner.get('integrity_status') == 'INVALID' or r.get('status') == 'INVALID' or inner.get('status') == 'INVALID' or any('NOT VERIFIED' in str(v) for v in checker.get('status_lines',[])) or p.name in supervised_runtime.NONSAT_VETO_FLAGS:
            invalid.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(LANE)),'error':'persistent INVALID/safety veto','sha256':E.digest(p)})
    return sats,invalid


def inspect_new(c,contract_sha,ca,it,verify_formula=False):
    p = LANE/it['new_record']
    if not p.exists():
        return {'state':'MISSING','errors':[],'sat':False}
    try:
        pin,commit = read(LANE/it['pin']),read(LANE/it['commit'])
        assert pin['schema'] == 'PA19-K1-CNF-PIN-v6' and commit['schema'] == 'PA19-K1-RECEIPT-v6'
        assert pin['production_contract_sha256'] == commit['production_contract_sha256'] == contract_sha
        assert type(pin['multiset']) is int and pin['multiset'] == 9
        assert type(pin['b_index']) is int and type(commit['b_index']) is int
        assert pin['b_index'] == commit['b_index'] == ca['b_index']
        idx = it['indices']
        assert pin['indices'] == commit['indices'] == idx
        val = next((x for x in c['validation_tasks'] if x['id'] == it['id']),None)
        if val:
            assert pin['cnf_sha256'] == val['expected']['cnf_sha256'] and pin['cnf_bytes'] == val['expected']['cnf_bytes']
        if idx is not None:
            assert isinstance(pin['indices'],list) and all(type(v) is int for v in pin['indices']+commit['indices'])
        recipe = pin['recipe']
        assert recipe['multiset'] == 9 and recipe['b_index'] == ca['b_index'] and recipe['indices'] == idx
        assert recipe['mode'] == ('direct' if idx is None else 'partbatch')
        if idx is not None:
            assert recipe['list_path'] == ca['list']['path'] and recipe['list_sha256'] == ca['list']['sha256'] and recipe['complete_denominator'] == ca['list']['n']
        assert recipe['skeleton_path'] == c['skeleton_path'] and recipe['skeleton_sha256'] == c['skeleton_sha256']
        assert recipe['encoder_sha256'] == c['source_sha256']['src/encode_skel_b.py']
        assert pin['source_sha256'] == c['source_sha256'] and pin['supervisor_sha256'] == c['supervisor']['sha256']
        assert pin['binary_authority'] == c['binary_authority']
        assert commit['pin_sha256'] == E.digest(LANE/it['pin']) and commit['record_sha256'] == E.digest(p)
        ctx = context(ca['b_index'],idx,pin['cnf_sha256'],pin['cnf_bytes'],True)
        ctx.update(lane_root=str(LANE),binary_authority=c['binary_authority'],source_sha256=c['source_sha256'],recipe=recipe)
        if verify_formula:
            raw = formula(c,ca,idx)
            assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == pin['cnf_sha256'] and len(raw) == pin['cnf_bytes']
        r = E.inspect(p,ctx,commit['record_sha256'])
        obj = r.get('record') or {}
        assert isinstance(obj,dict)
        assert obj.get('production_contract_sha256') == contract_sha and obj.get('pre_child_pin_sha256') == commit['pin_sha256']
        assert obj.get('count_for_scientific_coverage') is True and obj.get('runner') == 'run_m2_ms09_k1_v6.py'
        assert obj.get('pipeline_schema') == 'PA19-SUPERVISED-DRAT-v6'
        if idx is not None:
            assert obj.get('list_sha256') == ca['list']['sha256'] and obj.get('enumerator') == 'extend_b.py'
            assert type(obj.get('complete_denominator')) is int and obj['complete_denominator'] == ca['list']['n']
        return r
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,AssertionError,TypeError) as exc:
        return {'state':'INTEGRITY_VETO','errors':['new record/pin/commit binding failed: '+repr(exc)],'sat':False}






def inventory(c,contract_sha,verify_formulas=False):
    """Final coverage consumes ONLY complete measured-v3 inputs; historical outcomes remain separately visible."""
    verify_sources(c)
    sats,issues = sat_scan()
    rows,covered_indices,open_indices,original_only = [],0,0,[]
    for ca in c['cases']:
        bi = ca['b_index']
        if ca.get('direct'):
            dr = ca['direct']
            historical = E.inspect(LANE/dr['path'],dr['expected'],dr['sha256'])
            if historical['state'] != 'QUALIFIED': issues.append({'case':bi,'historical_direct':historical['errors']})
            task = ca['direct_task']
            chk = inspect_new(c,contract_sha,ca,task,verify_formulas)
            done = chk['state'] == 'QUALIFIED'
            if chk['state'] in ('INTEGRITY_VETO','HALT_UNKNOWN','SAT_VETO'): issues.append({'case':bi,'new_direct':chk['errors']})
            if not done and historical['state'] == 'QUALIFIED': original_only.append(task['id'])
            rows.append({'b_index':bi,'state':'DIRECT_CHECKED' if done else 'OPEN','solver_checked':done,
                         'historical_class':'ORIGINAL-QUALIFIED, exact checker input delivery NOT_RETAINED',
                         'validation':chk['state']})
            continue
        if ca['list']['n'] == 0:
            proof = structural_acceptance(c,ca)
            rows.append({'b_index':bi,'state':'STRUCTURAL_PARENT_MATH' if proof.get('accepted') else 'OPEN_EMPTY_NO_VACUOUS_ACCEPTANCE',
                         'solver_checked':False,'structural':proof})
            continue
        states = []
        for it in ca['intervals']:
            ident = it['id']
            historical_state = None
            if it.get('baseline'):
                ref = it['baseline']
                old = E.inspect(LANE/ref['path'],ref['expected'],ref['sha256'])
                historical_state = 'ORIGINAL-QUALIFIED' if old['state'] == 'QUALIFIED' else 'INVALID'
                if historical_state == 'INVALID': issues.append({'interval':ident,'historical':old['errors']})
            if ident in c['reserved_ids']:
                historical_state = 'CALIBRATION_ORIGINAL_COUNT_FALSE'
            chk = inspect_new(c,contract_sha,ca,it,verify_formulas)
            state = 'COVERED' if chk['state'] == 'QUALIFIED' else chk['state']
            if state in ('INTEGRITY_VETO','HALT_UNKNOWN','SAT_VETO'): issues.append({'interval':ident,'new':chk['errors']})
            if historical_state and state != 'COVERED': original_only.append(ident)
            size = it['indices'][1]-it['indices'][0]+1
            if state == 'COVERED': covered_indices += size
            else: open_indices += size
            states.append({'id':ident,'indices':it['indices'],'state':state,'historical_class':historical_state})
        done = bool(states) and all(s['state'] == 'COVERED' for s in states)
        rows.append({'b_index':bi,'state':'FULL_INTERVAL_UNION_CHECKED' if done else 'OPEN','solver_checked':done,
                     'denominator':ca['list']['n'],'intervals':states})
    resolved = sum(r['state'] in ('DIRECT_CHECKED','FULL_INTERVAL_UNION_CHECKED','STRUCTURAL_PARENT_MATH') for r in rows)
    for row in rows:
        row['closed_for_final'] = bool(verify_formulas and not sats and not issues and row['state'] in
                                      ('DIRECT_CHECKED','FULL_INTERVAL_UNION_CHECKED','STRUCTURAL_PARENT_MATH'))
    return {'scope':'ms09 component ONLY; not a global PA19/M1/other-multiset verdict','rows':rows,'cases':71,
            'progress_receipt_resolved_cases':resolved,'closed_cases_for_final':sum(r['closed_for_final'] for r in rows),
            'progress_solver_receipt_cases':sum(r['solver_checked'] for r in rows),
            'structural_parent_math_cases':sum(r['state'] == 'STRUCTURAL_PARENT_MATH' for r in rows),
            'covered_placement_indices':covered_indices,'open_placement_indices':open_indices,'sat_veto':sats,'integrity_issues':issues,
            'formula_verification_mode':verify_formulas,'final_ms09_acceptance_ready':bool(verify_formulas and resolved == 71 and not sats and not issues),
            'historical_inputs_pending_measured_validation':sorted(set(original_only)),
            'historical_outcomes_never_final_counted':True,'parent_calibration_reuse_permission':'WITHDRAWN',
            'admission_union':supervised_runtime.admission_union(LANE)}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Known v3 schema only: frozen binary authorities, measured feeds, explicit reaping and cached-census gates.
Rejected/incomplete evidence is scientific UNKNOWN; integrity/SAT/safety vetoes are separately persistent.
"""
import json
import stat
from pathlib import Path

import m2_supervised_runtime_v6 as R


def identity_errors(r,ex):
    if not isinstance(r,dict) or r.get('pipeline_schema') != 'PA19-SUPERVISED-DRAT-v6': return ['unsupported supervised schema']
    errors = []
    for key in ('multiset','b_index'):
        if type(r.get(key)) is not int or r[key] != ex[key]: errors.append('wrong '+key)
    if ex.get('indices') is None:
        if r.get('indices') is not None: errors.append('unexpected direct split')
    elif not isinstance(r.get('indices'),list) or any(type(v) is not int for v in r['indices']) or r['indices'] != ex['indices']:
        errors.append('wrong exact integer interval')
    if r.get('encoder') != ex['encoder']: errors.append('wrong independent encoder')
    if type(r.get('cnf_bytes')) is not int or r['cnf_bytes'] != ex['cnf_bytes'] or r.get('cnf_sha256') != ex['cnf_sha256']: errors.append('wrong exact CNF bytes/SHA')
    return errors


def gate_errors(g,ex,lane):
    errors = []
    def need(ok,msg):
        if not ok: errors.append(msg)
    try:
        need(g.get('admitted') is True and g.get('errors') == [],'admission refused/missing')
        need(type(g.get('count')) is int and 0 <= g['count'] <= 2,'COUNT ceiling')
        need(type(g.get('free_bytes')) is int and g['free_bytes'] >= g['required_free_bytes'] >= R.BASE_GATE+R.ITEM_GROWTH,'fresh statvfs/growth gate')
        need((g.get('rss') or {}).get('known') is True,'RSS unknown')
        need(g.get('group_rss_cap_bytes') == R.GROUP_RSS_CAP and g.get('busy_units') == 2 and g.get('lane_busy_ceiling') == 4,'normal resource budget differs')
        obs = g['binary_observations']
        need(set(obs) == set(ex['binary_authority']) == {'python','solver','checker'},'binary observation roles missing')
        for kind,authority in ex['binary_authority'].items():
            o = obs[kind]
            need(o.get('path') == authority['path'] and o.get('expected_sha256') == o.get('observed_sha256') == authority['sha256']
                 and o.get('matches') is True,'contract binary authority/observation differs: '+kind)
        c = g['census']; ref = c['reference']; path = Path(lane)/ref['path']
        need(path.resolve().is_relative_to((Path(lane)/'cycle2/accounting-v3').resolve()),'census path escapes')
        need(R.digest(path) == ref['sha256'],'census record SHA differs')
        saved = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
        need(saved == c['record'] and saved.get('schema') == 'PA19-ALLOCATED-CENSUS-v3','census contents/schema differ')
        need(saved.get('ttl_seconds') == R.CENSUS_TTL and saved['data']['known'] is True and saved['data']['stat_errors'] == [],'census unknown/TTL differs')
        age = g['at_monotonic']-saved['finished_monotonic']
        need(0 <= age <= R.CENSUS_TTL and 0 <= c['age_seconds'] <= R.CENSUS_TTL,'census stale at admission')
        usage = saved['data']['new_data_usage_upper_bytes']; bound = g['whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes']
        need(type(usage) is int and usage == c['current_data_upper_bytes'] and type(bound) is int and bound >= R.ALL_PLANNED_RETAINED_BOUND,'unknown/narrow whole-plan accounting')
        need(g['other_writer_margin_bytes'] == R.OTHER_WRITER_MARGIN and g['additional_data_cap_bytes'] == R.DATA_CAP
             and usage+bound+R.OTHER_WRITER_MARGIN <= R.DATA_CAP,'allocated-data reservation/margin cap')
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,AttributeError) as exc:
        errors.append('missing/invalid gate observation: '+repr(exc))
    return errors


def proof_errors(r,ex,lane):
    errors = identity_errors(r,ex)
    if errors: return errors
    def need(ok,msg):
        if not ok: errors.append(msg)
    need(r.get('status') == 'UNSAT' and r.get('checked') is True and r.get('integrity_status') == 'VALIDATED'
         and r.get('integrity_errors') == [] and r.get('sat_candidate') is False and r.get('halt_production') is False,'not a fully qualifying scientific UNSAT')
    try:
        authority = ex['binary_authority']
        need(r.get('binary_authority') == authority,'owner replaced frozen binary authority')
        sp = Path(lane)/r['supervisor_record']
        need(R.digest(sp) == r['supervisor_record_sha256'],'supervisor record SHA differs')
        sr = json.loads(sp.read_bytes())
        need(sr == r['supervisor'] and sr.get('supervisor_sha256') == R.SUP_SHA,'supervisor record/source differs')
        need(sr.get('completed_cleanly') is True and sr.get('uncertain') is False and not any(sr.get(k) for k in
             ('trip_reason','exception','quarantine_record','quarantine_write_error','cleanup_exception','record_write_error','stop_error','stop')),'supervisor safety trip/anomaly')
        final = sr.get('final_check') or {}
        need(final.get('problems') == [] and final.get('alive_others') == [] and isinstance(final.get('members'),list),'final group check missing/nonclean')
        settle = r['owner_settlement']
        need(settle.get('group_quiescent') is True and settle.get('leader_reaped') is True and settle.get('explicit_owned_popen_wait') is True
             and settle.get('owned_leader_pid') == sr['leader_pid'] and type(settle.get('leader_returncode')) is int and settle['leader_returncode'] == 0,'owned leader not explicitly waited/reaped')
        need(type(sr.get('leader_returncode')) is int and sr['leader_returncode'] == 0,'worker did not self-exit0')
        jp = Path(lane)/r['job_path']; need(R.digest(jp) == r['job_sha256'],'job SHA differs')
        job = json.loads(jp.read_bytes())
        need(job.get('schema') == 'PA19-NATIVE-JOB-v6' and job.get('source_sha256') == ex['source_sha256'] and job.get('recipe') == ex['recipe'],'job source/recipe differs')
        need(job.get('binary_authority') == job.get('lease',{}).get('binary_authority') == authority,'job authority differs from contract')
        need(job['cnf_sha256'] == ex['cnf_sha256'] and type(job['cnf_bytes']) is int and job['cnf_bytes'] == ex['cnf_bytes'],'job input differs')
        need(job['solver_seconds'] == ex['native_limit'] and job['checker_seconds'] == 1200,'native/check limit differs')
        expected_command = [authority['python']['path'],'-B',str(Path(lane)/'src/m2_native_staged_v6.py'),str(jp),r['job_sha256']]
        need(sr.get('command') == expected_command,'supervised worker argv differs')
        files = sr.get('command_files_sha256') or {}
        need(files.get(expected_command[0]) == authority['python']['sha256'] and files.get(str(jp)) == r['job_sha256']
             and files.get(expected_command[2]) == ex['source_sha256']['src/m2_native_staged_v6.py'],'supervised executable/source/job hashes differ')
        np = Path(lane)/r['worker_result_path']; need(R.digest(np) == r['worker_result_sha256'],'worker report SHA differs')
        native = json.loads(np.read_bytes())
        need(native == r['native_result'] and native.get('schema') == 'PA19-NATIVE-RESULT-v6','worker report differs')
        need(native.get('status') == 'UNSAT' and native.get('integrity_status') == 'VALIDATED' and native.get('integrity_errors') == []
             and native.get('sat_candidate') is False and native.get('halt_production') is False,'worker outcome unqualified')
        need(native.get('cnf_sha256') == ex['cnf_sha256'] and native.get('cnf_bytes') == ex['cnf_bytes'],'worker regenerated CNF differs')
        folder = Path(job['workdir']); need(folder.resolve().is_relative_to(Path(lane).resolve()),'FIFO directory escapes')
        for name in ('solver-cnf.fifo','checker-cnf.fifo','proof.fifo'):
            st = (folder/name).lstat(); need(stat.S_ISFIFO(st.st_mode) and st.st_size == 0,'CNF/proof transport is not an empty FIFO')
        limit = ex['native_limit']; solver = authority['solver']['path']
        prefix = [solver,'-q','-f','--seed=1','--time=%d' % limit] if job['solver'] == 'kissat' else [solver,'-q','-t',str(limit)]
        need(native.get('solver_command') == prefix+[str(folder/'solver-cnf.fifo'),str(folder/'proof.fifo')],'solver argv differs')
        need(native.get('checker_command') == [authority['checker']['path'],str(folder/'checker-cnf.fifo'),'-i','-t','1200'],'checker argv differs')
        for name in ('owner_preconstruction_gate','owner_prespawn_gate'):
            errors += [name+': '+e for e in gate_errors(r.get(name) or {},ex,lane)]
        errors += ['worker_preconstruction: '+e for e in gate_errors(native.get('worker_preconstruction_gate') or {},ex,lane)]
        gates = native.get('gates') or []
        need([g.get('phase') for g in gates] == ['solver','checker'],'both immediate native gates missing')
        for gate in gates: errors += [gate.get('phase','?')+': '+e for e in gate_errors(gate,ex,lane)]
        sc,dc = native['solver_collector'],native['checker_collector']
        need(all(k in sc and k in dc for k in ('complete','error','status_lines','sha256','bytes_read')),'collector observations missing')
        need(sc['complete'] is True and sc['error'] is None and sc['status_lines'] == ['s UNSATISFIABLE'],'solver exact completed verdict failed')
        need(dc['complete'] is True and dc['error'] is None and dc['status_lines'] == ['s VERIFIED'],'checker exact completed verdict failed')
        need(type(native.get('solver_rc')) is int and native['solver_rc'] == 20 and native.get('solver_stop') == 'self','solver not self20')
        need(type(native.get('checker_rc')) is int and native['checker_rc'] == 0 and native.get('checker_stop') == 'self','checker not self0')
        feeds = native['cnf_feeds']; need(set(feeds) == {'solver','checker'},'both CNF feeds required')
        for name,f in feeds.items():
            need(all(k in f for k in ('complete','close_ok','error','bytes','sha256')),'CNF observation fields missing: '+name)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exact106-item ms06 initial pass, common v3 transport: CaDiCaL300/check1200, no automatic retries.
All original outcomes (24 UNSAT,4 UNKNOWN at the v2 freeze) remain immutable. Only78 unattempted original IDs run.
Scientific failed certification stays UNKNOWN with separate integrity/safety veto. Miss set freezes ONCE only after
this initial pass is complete; no enumeration/helper launches from this file. Parent source PASS/GO required.
"""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import encode_skel_b as ENC
import m2_item_owner_v6 as OWNER
import m2_ms09_contract_v6 as COMMON
import m2_ms09_evidence_v6 as E
import m2_supervised_runtime_v6 as R
import run_m2_ms09_k1_v6 as TX

L = COMMON.LANE
QUEUE = 'cycle2/m2-jobs-hard-direct.txt'
SK = 'cycle2/skel-b/skeletons-b-ms06.json'
SCHEMA = 'PA19-MS06-INITIAL-DIRECT-v6'


def task(bi):
    base = 'cycle2/m2skel_drat/ms06_b%05d_v6' % bi
    return {'id':'ms06_b%05d' % bi,'indices':None,'new_record':base+'.json','pin':base+'.cnf-pin.json',
            'commit':base+'.receipt.json','claim':'cycle2/claims/ms06_direct_v6_b%05d.claim' % bi}


def queue_ids():
    ids = []
    for line in (L/QUEUE).read_text().splitlines():
        mi,interval = line.split(':'); lo,hi = map(int,interval.split('-'))
        assert mi == '6' and lo == hi and lo not in ids
        ids.append(lo)
    assert len(ids) == 106
    return ids


def freeze():
    rows = []
    for bi in queue_ids():
        old = L/'cycle2/m2skel_drat'/('ms06_b%05d.json' % bi)
        r = COMMON.read(old) if old.exists() else None
        if r is not None: assert r['multiset'] == 6 and r['b_index'] == bi and r['status'] != 'SAT'
        assert not (L/task(bi)['new_record']).exists()
        rows.append({'b_index':bi,'original_record':str(old.relative_to(L)) if r is not None else None,
                     'original_sha256':E.digest(old) if r is not None else None,'original_status':r.get('status') if r is not None else None})
    out = {'schema':SCHEMA,'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),'queue':QUEUE,'queue_sha256':E.digest(L/QUEUE),
        'skeleton_path':SK,'skeleton_sha256':E.digest(L/SK),'source_sha256':{p:E.digest(L/p) for p in COMMON.SOURCE_FILES},
        'supervisor_path':str(R.SUP_PATH),'supervisor_sha256':R.SUP_SHA,'resource_policy':COMMON.resource_policy(),
        'binary_authority':{kind:{'path':path,'sha256':E.digest(path)} for kind,path in
            [('python',os.path.abspath(sys.executable)),('solver','/opt/homebrew/bin/cadical'),('checker',str(L/'tools/drat-trim/drat-trim'))]},
        'rows':rows,'pending_order':[x['b_index'] for x in rows if x['original_record'] is None],
        'native_seconds':300,'check_seconds':1200,'count_ceiling':2,'automatic_retry_allowed':False,
        'no_helper_from_this_adapter':True,'original_outcomes_are_not_backfilled_or_final_qualified':True}
    dest = L/'cycle2'/('m2-ms06-initial-v6-contract-'+time.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')+'.json')
    h = COMMON.publish_json(dest,out,L/'scratch/m2k1-v6-publish'/('ms06-freeze-'+str(time.time_ns())))
    print(dest,h,'pending',len(out['pending_order']),flush=True)


def verify(c):
    assert c['schema'] == SCHEMA and c['queue'] == QUEUE and E.digest(L/QUEUE) == c['queue_sha256']
    assert c['skeleton_path'] == SK and E.digest(L/SK) == c['skeleton_sha256']
    assert set(c['source_sha256']) == set(COMMON.SOURCE_FILES)
    for p,h in c['source_sha256'].items(): assert E.digest(L/p) == h
    assert c['supervisor_sha256'] == R.SUP_SHA and E.digest(R.SUP_PATH) == R.SUP_SHA
    assert c['native_seconds'] == 300 and c['check_seconds'] == 1200 and c['count_ceiling'] == 2
    assert c['resource_policy'] == COMMON.resource_policy() and c['automatic_retry_allowed'] is False
    assert c['binary_authority']['solver']['path'] == '/opt/homebrew/bin/cadical'
    assert c['binary_authority']['checker']['path'] == str(L/'tools/drat-trim/drat-trim')
    assert c['pending_order'] == [x['b_index'] for x in c['rows'] if x['original_record'] is None]
    assert [x['b_index'] for x in c['rows']] == queue_ids()
    for x in c['rows']:
        if x['original_record']: assert E.digest(L/x['original_record']) == x['original_sha256']


def inspect(c,h,bi):
    it = task(bi)
    if not (L/it['new_record']).exists(): return {'state':'MISSING','record':None,'errors':[]}
    try:
        pin,k = COMMON.read(L/it['pin']),COMMON.read(L/it['commit'])
        assert pin['schema'] == 'PA19-K1-CNF-PIN-v6' and k['schema'] == 'PA19-K1-RECEIPT-v6'
        assert pin['production_contract_sha256'] == k['production_contract_sha256'] == h
        assert type(pin['multiset']) is int and pin['multiset'] == 6 and type(pin['b_index']) is int and pin['b_index'] == k['b_index'] == bi
        assert pin['indices'] is None and pin['source_sha256'] == c['source_sha256'] and pin['binary_authority'] == c['binary_authority']
        recipe = pin['recipe']
        assert recipe['mode'] == 'direct' and recipe['multiset'] == 6 and recipe['b_index'] == bi and recipe['indices'] is None
        assert recipe['skeleton_path'] == SK and recipe['skeleton_sha256'] == c['skeleton_sha256']
        assert recipe['encoder_sha256'] == c['source_sha256']['src/encode_skel_b.py']
        assert k['pin_sha256'] == E.digest(L/it['pin']) and k['record_sha256'] == E.digest(L/it['new_record'])
        ex = E.expected(6,bi,None,pin['cnf_sha256'],pin['cnf_bytes'],'encode_skel_b.build_v2',300,False)
        ex.update(binary_authority=c['binary_authority'],lane_root=str(L),source_sha256=c['source_sha256'],recipe=recipe)
        return E.inspect(L/it['new_record'],ex,k['record_sha256'])
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,AssertionError) as exc:
        return {'state':'INTEGRITY_VETO','errors':[repr(exc)]}


def freeze_misses(c,h):
    dest = L/'cycle2/ms06-initial-v6-UNKNOWN-misses-ONCE.json'; assert not dest.exists()
    rows = []
    for x in c['rows']:
        bi = x['b_index']
        if x['original_record']: r,rel = COMMON.read(L/x['original_record']),x['original_record']
        else:
            q = inspect(c,h,bi)
            assert q['state'] not in ('MISSING','INTEGRITY_VETO','SAT_VETO','HALT_UNKNOWN'), ('initial pass incomplete/veto',bi,q)
            r,rel = q['record'],task(bi)['new_record']
        if r.get('status') != 'UNSAT' or r.get('checked') is not True:
            rows.append({'job':'6:%d' % bi,'b_index':bi,'record':rel,'record_sha256':E.digest(L/rel),
                'cnf_sha256':r['cnf_sha256'],'cnf_bytes':r['cnf_bytes'],'status':'UNKNOWN','already_enumerated':bi in (68,73)})
    out = {'schema':'PA19-MS06-UNKNOWN-SET-v6','host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),'initial_contract_sha256':h,
        'source_sha256':c['source_sha256'],'skeleton_sha256':c['skeleton_sha256'],'jobs':rows,
        'scope':'exact accumulated initial-pass UNKNOWN set; NO helper admission/denominator supplied here',
        'requires_new_source_denominator_growth_review_before_any_helper':True}
    rh = COMMON.publish_json(dest,out,L/'scratch/m2k1-v6-publish'/('ms06-misses-'+str(time.time_ns())))
    print(dest,rh,'UNKNOWN',len(rows),flush=True)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument('contract',nargs='?'); ap.add_argument('sha256',nargs='?')
    ap.add_argument('--freeze',action='store_true'); ap.add_argument('--freeze-misses',action='store_true'); ap.add_argument('--max-attempts',type=int,default=8)
    args = ap.parse_args(); R.install_handlers()
    cutoff = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat('2026-10-18T18:31:43-07:00').timestamp()
    deadline = min(time.monotonic()+10800,time.monotonic()+max(0,cutoff-time.time()))
    with R.Capacity(deadline,metadata=True,wait_allowance=60):
        st = os.statvfs(L); assert st.f_bavail*st.f_frsize >= R.BASE_GATE+1024**2
        if args.freeze: freeze(); return
        assert args.contract and args.sha256 and E.digest(args.contract) == args.sha256
        c = COMMON.read(args.contract); verify(c)
        if args.freeze_misses: freeze_misses(c,args.sha256); return
        # Same shared persistent-veto registry as every gate/inventory, plus this adapter's own existing records.
        union = R.admission_union(L)
        vetoes,stops = union['persistent_vetoes'],union['resource_stops']
        record_vetoes = {}
        for x in c['rows']:
            if (L/task(x['b_index'])['new_record']).exists():
                state = inspect(c,args.sha256,x['b_index'])['state']
                if state in ('INTEGRITY_VETO','SAT_VETO','HALT_UNKNOWN'): record_vetoes[x['b_index']] = state
        if vetoes or record_vetoes or stops:
            logs = L/'cycle2/m2k3-chunks'/('ms06-%s-%d' % (time.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S'),time.time_ns()))
            logs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
            COMMON.publish_json(logs/'initialization-deferred.json',{'status':'UNKNOWN',
                'init_stage':'veto-scan' if (vetoes or record_vetoes) else 'resource-stop',
                'reason':'persistent veto or resource STOP present; no claim or native admission','veto_markers':vetoes,
                'resource_stops':stops,'admission_union':union,'record_vetoes':record_vetoes,
                'native_has_started':False,'contract_sha256':args.sha256,'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')},
                L/'scratch/m2k1-v6-publish'/('ms06-veto-'+str(time.time_ns())))
            print('M6 initialization veto',vetoes,record_vetoes,flush=True)
            return
        assert args.max_attempts > 0 and all(v['matches'] for v in R.binary_observations(c['binary_authority']).values())
        reference = R.create_census(); census = R.census_for_gate(reference)
        assert census['current_data_upper_bytes']+R.ALL_PLANNED_RETAINED_BOUND+R.OTHER_WRITER_MARGIN <= R.DATA_CAP
        admission = {'binary_authority':c['binary_authority'],'census_reference':reference,
                     'whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes':c['resource_policy']['whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes']}
        D = COMMON.read(L/SK); special = [p for p in D['profiles'] if list(p) != COMMON.P0]
    stage = L/'scratch/m2k1-v6-publish'/('ms06-'+str(time.time_ns())); attempts = 0
    for bi in c['pending_order']:
        if attempts >= args.max_attempts or R._CANCEL[0] or time.monotonic()+2550 > deadline: return
        it = task(bi)
        if (L/it['new_record']).exists():
            q = inspect(c,args.sha256,bi)
            if q['state'] in ('INTEGRITY_VETO','SAT_VETO','HALT_UNKNOWN'): raise RuntimeError('persistent existing veto '+repr(q))
            continue  # every previous UNKNOWN remains, no direct retry
        if not TX.claim(it['claim'],args.sha256,it['id']): continue
        recipe = {'mode':'direct','multiset':6,'b_index':bi,'indices':None,'skeleton_path':SK,
                  'skeleton_sha256':c['skeleton_sha256'],'encoder_sha256':c['source_sha256']['src/encode_skel_b.py']}
        def build():
            verify(c)
            sk = D['skeletons'][bi]
            nv,cl = ENC.build_v2(D['c0'],[tuple(t) for t in sk['types']],sk['empty'],special)
            return ENC.cnf_bytes(nv,cl)
        paths = TX.item_paths(it,stage)
        r = OWNER.execute(build,recipe,args.sha256,c['source_sha256'],paths,deadline,admission,'cadical',300)
        if r.get('unattempted') == 'before-pin' and not (L/it['pin']).exists():
            TX.release_unattempted(it['claim'],'refusal rule1: direct refused before pin/job; no record or HALT'); return
        if r.get('unattempted') == 'after-pin-before-worker':
            TX.retire_unattempted_after_pin(it,paths,'refusal rule2: direct refused before worker; no record or HALT'); return
        if not r.get('pre_child_pin_sha256'):

        r.update(runner='run_m2_ms06_direct_v6.py',count_for_scientific_coverage=True)
        raw = (json.dumps(r,indent=1)+'\n').encode(); rh = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
        COMMON.publish_json(L/it['commit'],{'schema':'PA19-K1-RECEIPT-v6','production_contract_sha256':args.sha256,
            'b_index':bi,'record_sha256':rh,'pin_sha256':r['pre_child_pin_sha256']},stage)
        COMMON.publish_bytes(L/it['new_record'],raw,stage)
        attempts += 1
        print(json.dumps({'job':'6:%d' % bi,'record':it['new_record'],'sha256':rh,'status':r['status'],

        for gate in (r.get('native_result') or {}).get('gates') or []:
